title: Plink-Plonk Pebble Puffer
statement: Drifting through twilight-blue water framed by mossy slate shelves and swaying amber kelp, this plump, softly glowing fish spends its days nudging smooth river stones and frosted sea-glass into intricate, ever-changing mosaics across the sandy floor. Whenever a pattern feels complete, it celebrates with a proud flutter of iridescent fins and a shimmering spiral of bubbles before happily scattering the pieces to invent a brand-new design.
